data.title: Why Rivers Flood
data.passage: Heavy spring rain falls on the mountains. Therefore, melting snow rushes down the steep slopes. Rivers fill up very fast. Water spills over the muddy riverbanks. As a result, nearby towns wake up to flooded streets. People move their precious belongings to higher ground.
